items.title: 5.4.1 Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole forces (London dispersion forces) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 5.4.1, printed pages 98-100, with Quick Check 5.2 and answers.

blocks.title: Instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force
blocks.text: Ek lamhati (instantaneous, sirf ek pal ka) dipole aur us se paida hone wale (induced) dipole ke darmiyan pal bhar ki kashish ko instantaneous dipole-induced dipole force kehte hain.
Non-polar compounds ke molecules ke darmiyan sirf yehi forces hoti hain. In forces ki taqat neeche diye gaye factors (asar karne wali cheezon) par munhasir hai.

Compound ka molecular mass (Mᵣ) jitna zyada, id-id forces utni mazboot; aur mass kam to forces kamzor. Wajah: bare atom ya molecule ka electron cloud asani se phail aur khisak (polarise ho) jata hai. Yeh baat halogen aur noble gas families mein nazar aati hai. Halogen family mein upar se neeche size aur polarizability barhti hai, is liye physical state badalti hai: pehle do members (F₂ aur Cl₂) gas hain, bromine liquid aur iodine solid (b.p. = 458 K). Group 18 ki noble gases ke boiling points bhi helium (He) se xenon (Xe) tak barhte hain, jaisa Table 5.1 mein hai.

blocks.caption: Table 5.1 Group 17 aur 18 ke molar masses aur boiling points

blocks.text: Jis molecule ka surface area bara ho, woh paas wale molecule ko zyada jagahon se chhoota (contact karta) hai, is liye us ki forces mazboot hoti hain. Saturated hydrocarbons dekhein: in mein carbon atoms ki zanjeer (chain) hoti hai jis se hydrogen atoms jure hote hain. C₂H₆ aur C₆H₁₄ ki chain ki lambai ka muqabla karein: un ke boiling points −88.6 °C aur 68.7 °C hain. Saaf hai ke lambi chain wale molecules mein kashish zyada hai, kyunke lambe molecule ki lambai ke saath zyada jagahen hain jahan doosre molecules us se khinch sakte hain. Kuch hydrocarbons ke boiling points Table 5.2 mein hain.

blocks.caption: Table 5.2 Kuch hydrocarbons ke boiling points aur physical states

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab Table 5.2 mein “Isodecane (C₂₀H₄₂)” likhti hai. C₂₀H₄₂ ka sahi naam icosane (eicosane) hai: 20 carbon wali seedhi chain, room temperature par solid. Isodecane decane (C₁₀H₂₂) ka branched isomer hai.

Pentane ke teen isomers ka relative molecular mass (Mᵣ) ek jaisa hai, lekin un ka surface area mukhtalif hai. Seedhi chain wale pentane (n-pentane) ka surface area sab se bara hai, is liye us ka boiling point bhi teenon mein sab se zyada hai. 2-Methylbutane (isopentane) ka surface area n-pentane se kam magar 2,2-dimethylpropane (neopentane) se zyada hai. Is liye 2-methylbutane mein forces darmiyani hain aur sab se kamzor forces 2,2-dimethylpropane mein hain. Figure 5.2 mein teenon isomers aur un ke boiling points diye gaye hain.

blocks.alt: Gulabi shaklon par teen condensed structural formulas. Pentane (n-pentane): H3C-CH2-CH2-CH2-CH3 zigzag zanjeer, b.p. 36.2 degrees C. 2-Methylbutane (iso-pentane): zanjeer H3C-CH-CH2-CH3, doosre carbon par CH3 shaakh (branch), b.p. 28 degrees C. 2,2-Dimethylpropane (neo-pentane): beech wala carbon chaar CH3 groups se juda, gathi hui (compact) shakal, b.p. 9.5 degrees C.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.2: Pentane ke teen isomers ki banawat, surface area aur intermolecular forces mukhtalif hain (kitab ki Figure 5.2 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Gulabi (pink) shakal har molecule ki bahar ki satah (surface) dikhati hai. Seedhi chain (n-pentane) ki satah sab se lambi hai, is liye paas wale molecules se contact zyada aur London forces mazboot: b.p. sab se zyada (36.2 °C). Neo-pentane gend (ball) jaisa gol hai, contact kam, b.p. sab se kam (9.5 °C).

blocks.prompt: a) Petrol ki quality behtar karne ke liye gasoline hisse ke seedhi chain wale hydrocarbons ko branched chain mein badla jata hai. Is ki kya wajah ho sakti hai?
blocks.explanation: Branched molecule gol (compact) hota hai, us ka surface area kam hai, is liye London forces kamzor aur boiling point kam hota hai. Aisa fuel asani se vapour ban kar engine mein hamwar (smoothly) jalta hai aur knocking kam hoti hai.

blocks.prompt: b) CCl₄ aur SiF₄ ke molecules ke darmiyan kaun si forces hain?
blocks.explanation: Dono symmetrical tetrahedral, non-polar molecules hain (bond dipoles ek doosre ko khatam kar dete hain), is liye in ke darmiyan sirf London (id-id) forces hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: c) Misalon ke saath id-id aur pd-pd forces mein farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: id-id (London) forces electron cloud ki pal bhar ki na-barabari se banti hain, har molecule mein hoti hain, aur non-polar cheezon (Cl₂, CCl₄, noble gases) mein sirf yehi hoti hain. pd-pd forces sirf un polar molecules mein hoti hain jin ka mustaqil (permanent) dipole ho, jaise HCl aur CHCl₃; un ka musbat sira agle molecule ke manfi sire ko khinchta hai.

items: London (id-id) force: lamhati dipole doosre molecule mein dipole paida karta hai; non-polar molecules mein sirf yehi force.
Mass aur size barhe to force mazboot (F₂ gas se I₂ solid; He 4.22 K se Xe 165 K). Surface area barhe to force mazboot (n-pentane 36.2 > isopentane 28 > neopentane 9.5 °C).
